ns2:section.sectionText: This course will focus on ecological restoration within Alabama's coastal habitats of which several are endangered. The course will meet on-line every Tuesday evening (except March 22, 2011) and culminate in a 5-7 day field study trip to coastal Alabama in May 2011 shortly after the semester's end. A $1500 fee will be charged for lodging, surface transportation, etc. Contact Dr. Endress for additional information: 217-244-1679 or aendress@illinois.edu. Instructor approval is required to enroll in this course. Students will need a working external microphone and speakers, or a headset with microphone and high speed internet. Wireless internet is not recommended.
